narrative.overview: 个人学习库房：借用 Obsidian 的左知识库、中央标签、右上下文助手工作语法，但保持知学空间自己的浅色、柔紫、紧凑且功能真实的产品外观。

rules.name: Context follows selection
rules.body: Knowledge selection, center tabs, graph context, question context, and Tutor citations must stay aligned to the same real knowledge base.

rules.name: Flat persistent workspace
rules.body: Persistent panels use surface tone and one-pixel boundaries; only drawers receive elevation.

rules.name: One accent
rules.body: Use #6558c9 for primary and selected states; reserve #167c59 for semantic success.

rules.name: Responsive without state loss
rules.body: At 1280, 960, 720, and mobile thresholds, drawers change presentation without destroying selection, tabs, graph, or Tutor state.

rules.name: Honest function boundary
rules.body: Buttons invoke real behavior or expose clear disabled, empty, loading, permission, configuration, or error states.

dos: Keep knowledge name and graph actions as separate accessible targets.
Use 13px base copy, 12px supporting copy, visible focus rings, and 44px mobile controls.
Open Tutor citations in the matching real knowledge preview.
Respect reduced motion and avoid page-level horizontal scrolling.
donts: Do not copy Obsidian brand styling or add decorative dashboard chrome.
Do not add fake controls, browser-stored model keys, or decorative status pills.
Do not use static card shadows, glassmorphism, gradient glows, or metric-card walls.
Do not let responsive drawers reset learning or conversation state.
